sources.note: No paid reference scrape was run. Structure and section rhythm come from the owl template (the sole source of truth for design); palette and typography are re-derived from the client's own brand tokens captured in intake-scraped.json. Anti-patterns merge reference-libraries/default.json with tells found in audit_results.json.

contrast_check.notes: on_accent is white at 3.77:1 — valid only because every accent-backed label in the owl template is 20px/700, where the AA threshold is 3:1. Do not shrink accent buttons below 1.25rem. accent_ink (#0b5f81) is the foreground variant for eyebrows, ticks, stars and chevrons on light backgrounds; dark primary panels keep the full accent (3.73:1).

typography.source: Both detected on the client's existing site (Google Fonts: Poppins 400/500/600/700 and Lato 400). Retained as brand tokens.

section_styling_hints: Deep navy-teal (#0a2f40) panels for the trust, process and testimonial bands — carries the brand blue without the washed-out light-on-light problem of the current site
Brand blue reserved for CTAs, eyebrows and tick marks, not for body text
Real crew photography from the client's own library — no stock
avoid: script / handwriting typefaces for headlines (the current site's clipped cursive hero)
light blue body text on white — the current site's dominant contrast failure
JavaScript-dependent carousels that leave blank voids before hydration
burying the 'One Maid. Same Maid. Every Time.' promise below the fold
